IC1: The subject must be willingly and able to provide written informed consent
IC2: Age 19 years of age or older (The age of consent in Nebraska)
IC3: HCV [AND] [NOT] treatment-naïve, as defined as [NOT] no prior exposure to any Interferon (IFN) [OR], RBV, or other FDA approved or experimental HCV-specific direct-acting antiviral agent
IC4: HCV RNA level at most 6 months prior to the Baseline/Day 1 visit.
IC5: HCV genotyping 1a, 1b, or mixed 1a/ab. Any non-definitive results will exclude the subject from study participation.
IC6: Alcohol misuse as defined by the Alcohol Use Disorders Identification Test (AUDIT) score subjects must score > 8 (associated with harmful or hazardous drinking)
IC7: History of a liver biopsy [AND] showing cirrhosis (e.g. Metavir score [OR] = 4 or Ishak score > 5)
IC8: Fibroscan showing cirrhosis [OR] or results > 12.5 kPa
IC9: FIBRO Spect II index [AND] consistent with F3 or F4 AND an AST : platelet ration index (APRI) of > 2 during Screening
IC10: Liver biopsy [AND] within 2 years of Screening showing [NOT] absence of cirrhosis
IC11: Fibroscan within 6 months of Baseline/Day1 with a result of = 12.5 kPa
IC12: FIBRO Spect II Index [AND] consistent with F0- F2 AND APRI of = 1 during Screening
IC13: Liver imaging [AND] within 6 months of Baseline/Day 1 to [NOT] exclude hepatocellular carcinoma HCC) is required
IC14: ALT < 10 x the upper limit of normal (ULN)
IC19: Creatinine clearance (CLcr) = 60 mL /min, as calculated by the Cockcroft-Gault equation
IC20: Hemoglobin = 11 g/dL for female [OR] subjects; = 12 g/dL for male subjects.
IC22: INR = 1.5 x ULN [NOT] unless subject has known hemophilia [OR] or is stable on an anticoagulant regimen affecting INR.
IC23: Subject has not been treated with any investigational drug or device within 30 days of the screening visit.
